title.en: Meta makes Muse Ember available via Muse Code and its Model API
title.zhHans: Meta 通过 Muse Code 和 Model API 提供 Muse Ember

searchSummary.en: Meta said Muse Ember was available on Muse Code and the Meta Model API on November 9.
searchSummary.zhHans: Meta 表示 Muse Ember 于 11 月 9 日在 Muse Code 与 Meta Model API 上提供。

summary.en: On November 9, Meta announced that Muse Ember, its smaller agent-oriented model, was available on Muse Code and the Meta Model API. Its price and benchmark comparisons are separate from evidence of actual customer use.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 9 日，Meta 宣布面向智能体任务的较小模型 Muse Ember 已可通过 Muse Code 和 Meta Model API 使用。标价和跑分对比不能证明客户实际采用。

narrative.en: Meta describes tool-use and coding tasks for the model. Artificial Analysis independently evaluated its performance, but its per-task cost is calculated for benchmark tasks, and benchmark results do not measure outside organizations’ production adoption. Meta’s own availability statement is not a measurement of external reach.
narrative.zhHans: Meta 将该模型定位于工具调用与编程等任务。Artificial Analysis 对模型表现进行了独立评测，但单任务成本按基准测试任务计算；基准测试无法衡量外部机构的生产采用。Meta 的可用性声明也不等于外部覆盖范围的实测。

text.en: Meta announced that Muse Ember was available on Muse Code and the Meta Model API on November 9.
text.zhHans: Meta 宣布 Muse Ember 于 11 月 9 日已在 Muse Code 和 Meta Model API 上提供。

claims.notes: First-party release establishes an announced availability, not actual independent uptake.

text.en: Artificial Analysis evaluated Muse Ember and noted verbose output; its per-task cost is for benchmark tasks, not a measurement of production adoption.
text.zhHans: Artificial Analysis 评测了 Muse Ember 并指出其输出偏冗长；单任务成本针对基准测试任务，并非生产环境采用规模的测量。

claims.notes: Original evaluator analysis is independent of Meta for its benchmark, but not a measurement of actual enterprise adoption.

editorial.reviewNotes: This bounded published-state candidate was prepared Nov20 from a full-body reviewed-state audit. Meta first-party availability and AA benchmark do not establish actual customer uptake. Approval and production deployment are tracked separately, not asserted by this note.
